COMMAND

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x0
Size:
0x4

Description

Write-1 command pulses, read as 0. SOFT_RESET > ABORT > LOAD_WEIGHTS/START. LOAD_WEIGHTS and START together -> CMD_ERR.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:4] - - - -
[3] SOFT_RESET w 0x0 -
[2] ABORT w 0x0 -
[1] START w 0x0 -
[0] LOAD_WEIGHTS w 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

SOFT_RESET

ABORT + forget weights + clear control state. CSR config and ERROR_STATUS are kept.

ABORT

Stop issuing requests, discard in-flight results. Keeps WEIGHTS_LOADED (unless it hit a weight load).

START

Stream ACT_COUNT activation rows from memory, write results to DST_ADDR. Needs WEIGHTS_LOADED, accepted only when idle.

LOAD_WEIGHTS

Fetch bias (if BIAS_EN) and weights from memory into the array. Accepted only when idle.
